final_goals: F1910M PRIORITY #1: F TYS→ROM (empty Rome = guaranteed SC #10). F ION supports to guarantee even if A VEN→ROM attempted.
F1910M PRIORITY #2: A ALB→SER supported by A BUL (unoccupied Austrian SC = SC #11). Both targets require zero external support.
F1910M DEFENSE: F BLA S A SEV H blocks Austrian A RUM→SEV. A BER H protects Berlin.
POST-FALL TARGETS: With 11 SCs, next targets are NAP (F ION or chain advancement), then TUN. Fleet chain at ROM/TYS/ION positions perfectly for continued Italian coastal seizures.

STRATEGIC: Now at war with BOTH Italy and Austria. Italy's main force is in the west (BUR/PIC/BEL/ENG/MAO/MUN) - only A VEN near me. Austria has 5 units but loses SER down to 4 SCs. Geographic position strong - I threaten both from interior lines.
GERMANY PRESERVATION: Keep Germany alive as buffer. Their F KIE blocks Italian expansion northward. A BER H denies Italy any easy northern gains.
ENGLAND UTILITY: Don't rely on England for anything but hope they independently pressure Italy from north (NTH/LON/SWE). Any English pressure on Italy helps me regardless of coordination.
SC PATH TO 18: Current 9 + ROM(10) + SER(11). Then NAP(12), TUN(13), RUM(14), BUD(15) from Austria. Then assess remaining 3 SCs from Italy/England depending on board state.
